name: Crystal Rotate Left Video Background
description: A full-screen hero section with an autoplaying background video and a soft left-to-right white gradient overlay for a clean, airy presentation.
visual_description: A minimal full-viewport section with a muted video filling the entire screen. The video fades in smoothly and is partially washed by a bright white gradient overlay that is strongest on the right side, creating a light, crystal-like aesthetic.
